# Expert Opportunity - Enterprise Account Executive (B2B)

($80/hr, up to $1.6k/week)

Share
[Apply](https://agent.askethos.com/opportunities/enterprise-account-executive-b2b/apply)

Role

enterprise sales expert

Interview

AI voice screen included

## About this opportunity

We're working with a leading foundational AI lab to find experienced enterprise sales executives who can help train their latest language model on professional presentation and slide deck tasks.
We're looking for AEs with 5+ years selling complex B2B deals at top companies to create, evaluate, and refine AI-generated presentations and slide decks across core workflows: customer pitch decks, executive briefing presentations, business case and ROI slides, proposal decks, QBR materials, and deal review one-pagers.

**Compensation:** $80/hour

**Commitment:** Flexible, 5-20 hours per week (or more if desired)

**Location:** Fully remote, work on your own schedule

**Start date:** ASAP

**Qualifications:**

- 5+ years in enterprise B2B sales at a top technology or services company
- Track record of building your own customer-facing decks for six/seven-figure deals
- Expert-level PowerPoint and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail

### About Ethos

Ethos is a new expert network built by a McKinsey/SoftBank/DeepMind team and backed by world-leading investors like General Catalyst. We connect experts with investors and consultancies for paid expert calls, speaking engagements, and advisory opportunities.

## Key requirements

- 5+ years in enterprise B2B sales at a top technology or services company
- Track record of building your own customer-facing decks for six/seven-figure deals
- Expert-level PowerPoint and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail

Interested in this opportunity?

Submit your application and our team will review it. You may be invited to a short AI voice screen as a next step.

[Apply Now](https://agent.askethos.com/opportunities/enterprise-account-executive-b2b/apply)
